headline: Heating Oil at 1.55 Euros: Subsidy of 40 Cents per Liter, 20 on Diesel and 10 on Gasoline – All the Measures
summary: Greece announced a 40-cent-per-liter reduction on heating oil, a 30% increase in the heating allowance of up to 1,560 euros for beneficiaries, and cuts of 20 cents on diesel and 10 cents on gasoline.
why: Heating oil and fuel prices feed directly into household energy costs and inflation, and government fuel subsidies affect public finances and fuel-retail margins.
